verses.ar: وَالذّٰرِيٰتِ ذَرۡوًاۙ‏
verses.en: By those (winds) that scatter dust,

verses.ar: فَالۡحٰمِلٰتِ وِقۡرًاۙ‏
verses.en: then those that bear load (of clouds),

verses.ar: فَالۡجٰرِيٰتِ يُسۡرًاۙ‏
verses.en: then those that float with ease,

verses.ar: فَالۡمُقَسِّمٰتِ اَمۡرًاۙ‏
verses.en: then those who distribute things,

verses.ar: اِنَّمَا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ لَصَادِقٌۙ‏
verses.en: whatever you are being promised is surely true,

verses.ar: وَّاِنَّ الدِّيۡنَ لَوَاقِعٌؕ‏
verses.en: and Recompense (of deeds) is sure to happen.

verses.ar: وَالسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ الۡحُبُكِۙ‏
verses.en: By the sky, having paths,

verses.ar: اِنَّكُمۡ لَفِيۡ قَوۡلٍ مُّخۡتَلِفٍۙ‏
verses.en: you are (involved) in a contradictory discussion.

verses.ar: يُّؤۡفَكُ عَنۡهُ مَنۡ اُفِكَؕ‏
verses.en: Turned away from this (Qur’ān) is the one who is turned away (totally from the truth.)

verses.ar: قُتِلَ الۡخَرّٰصُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Death upon those who make conjectures (against the true faith),

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ فِيۡ غَمۡرَةٍ سَاهُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: - those who are drowned in ignorance, forgetful!

verses.ar: يَسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ اَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ الدِّيۡنِؕ‏
verses.en: They ask, “When shall be the Day of Recompense?”

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ عَلَي النَّارِ يُفۡتَنُوۡنَ
verses.en: (It will be) the Day when they will be heated on the Fire,

verses.ar: ذُوۡقُوۡا فِتۡنَتَكُمۡؕ هٰذَا الَّذِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: (and it will be said to them,) “Taste (the punishment of) your mischief. This is what you have been asking to be brought sooner.”

verses.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِيۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوۡنٍۙ‏
verses.en: The God-fearing (on the other hand) will be in gardens and springs,

verses.ar: اٰخِذِيۡنَ مَا٘ اٰتٰىهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَبۡلَ ذٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: receiving what their Lord will have given to them. Indeed, prior to this, they were good in their deeds.

verses.ar: كَانُوۡا قَلِيۡلًا مِّنَ الَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: They used to sleep little in the night;

verses.ar: وَبِالۡاَسۡحَارِ هُمۡ يَسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: and in the hours before dawn they used to pray for forgiveness,

verses.ar: وَفِيۡ٘ اَمۡوَالِهِمۡ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَالۡمَحۡرُوۡمِ
verses.en: and in their wealth, there was a right for one who asks and for one who is deprived.

verses.ar: وَفِي الۡاَرۡضِ اٰيٰتٌ لِّلۡمُوۡقِنِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: In the earth, there are signs for those who (seek truth to) believe,

verses.ar: وَفِيۡ٘ اَنۡفُسِكُمۡؕ اَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: and in your own selves! So, do you not perceive?

verses.ar: وَفِي السَّمَآءِ رِزۡقُكُمۡ وَمَا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: And in the heavens, there is your sustenance and all that you have been promised.

verses.ar: فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَآءِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ اِنَّهٗ لَحَقٌّ مِّثۡلَ مَا٘ اَنَّكُمۡ تَنۡطِقُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: So, by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it (the Day of Recompense) is a reality, as sure as the fact that you (can) speak.

verses.ar: هَلۡ اَتٰىكَ حَدِيۡثُ ضَيۡفِ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ الۡمُكۡرَمِيۡنَۘ‏
verses.en: Has there come to you the story of the honoured guests of Ibrāhīm?

verses.ar: اِذۡ دَخَلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُوۡا سَلٰمًاؕ قَالَ سَلٰمٌۚ قَوۡمٌ مُّنۡكَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: When they (the angels in human form) entered unto him and said, “We greet you with Salām .” He said, “Salām on you.” (And he said to himself,) “(They are) unknown people.”

verses.ar: فَرَاغَ اِلٰ٘ي اَهۡلِهٖ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلٍ سَمِيۡنٍۙ‏
verses.en: Then he slipped off to his home and fetched a fattened calf.

verses.ar: فَقَرَّبَهٗ٘ اِلَيۡهِمۡ قَالَ اَلَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَؗ‏
verses.en: So he presented it before them (to eat, but being angels, they refrained.) He said, “Would you not eat?”

verses.ar: فَاَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيۡفَةًؕ قَالُوۡا لَا تَخَفۡؕ وَبَشَّرُوۡهُ بِغُلٰمٍ عَلِيۡمٍ
verses.en: So he felt some fear in his heart. They said, “Be not scared.” And they gave him the good news of (the birth of) a knowledgeable boy.

verses.ar: فَاَقۡبَلَتِ امۡرَاَتُهٗ فِيۡ صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوۡزٌ عَقِيۡمٌ
verses.en: So his wife came forward with a clamor, and slapped her own face and said, “(How can I have a child when I am) a barren old woman?”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا كَذٰلِكِۙ قَالَ رَبُّكِؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡحَكِيۡمُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
verses.en: They said, “This is how your Lord has said. Surely, He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.”

verses.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ اَيُّهَا الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: He (Ibrāhīm) said (to the angels), “Then, what is your mission O messengers?”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا٘ اُرۡسِلۡنَا٘ اِلٰي قَوۡمٍ مُّجۡرِمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: They said, “We are sent to a guilty people, (i.e. the people of Sodom)

verses.ar: لِنُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةً مِّنۡ طِيۡنٍۙ‏
verses.en: so that we may send down upon them stones of clay,

verses.ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِيۡنَ
verses.en: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”

verses.ar: فَاَخۡرَجۡنَا مَنۡ كَانَ فِيۡهَا مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: So, We let the believers who were there to come out (from danger),

verses.ar: فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيۡهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتٍ مِّنَ الۡمُسۡلِمِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: but We did not find in it any Muslims, except one house.

verses.ar: وَتَرَكۡنَا فِيۡهَا٘ اٰيَةً لِّلَّذِيۡنَ يَخَافُوۡنَ الۡعَذَابَ الۡاَلِيۡمَؕ‏
verses.en: And We left in this (event) a sign (of deterrence) for those who fear the painful punishment.

verses.ar: وَفِيۡ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اِذۡ اَرۡسَلۡنٰهُ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.en: And (We left a similar sign) in (the story of) Mūsā, when We sent him to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) with a clear proof.

verses.ar: فَتَوَلّٰي بِرُكۡنِهٖ وَقَالَ سٰحِرٌ اَوۡ مَجۡنُوۡنٌ
verses.en: So he turned away along with his chiefs and said, “ (Mūsā is) a magician or a madman!”

verses.ar: فَاَخَذۡنٰهُ وَجُنُوۡدَهٗ فَنَبَذۡنٰهُمۡ فِي الۡيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيۡمٌؕ‏
verses.en: So We seized him and his army, and cast them into the sea, as he was of culpable behaviour.

verses.ar: وَفِيۡ عَادٍ اِذۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ الرِّيۡحَ الۡعَقِيۡمَۚ‏
verses.en: And (a similar sign was left) in (the story of) ‘Ād, when We sent upon them the wind that was barren (from any benefit);

verses.ar: مَا تَذَرُ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍ اَتَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ اِلَّا جَعَلَتۡهُ كَالرَّمِيۡمِؕ‏
verses.en: it spared nothing it came upon, but rendered it like a stuff smashed by decay.

verses.ar: وَفِيۡ ثَمُوۡدَ اِذۡ قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ تَمَتَّعُوۡا حَتّٰي حِيۡنٍ
verses.en: And (a similar sign was left) in (the story of) Thamūd, when it was said to them, “Enjoy yourselves for a while.”

verses.ar: فَعَتَوۡا عَنۡ اَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الصّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Then they rebelled against the command of your Lord; so the thunderbolt (of divine punishment) seized them, while they were looking on.

verses.ar: فَمَا اسۡتَطَاعُوۡا مِنۡ قِيَامٍ وَّمَا كَانُوۡا مُنۡتَصِرِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Then they were neither able to stand (before the punishment), nor could they defend themselves.

verses.ar: وَقَوۡمَ نُوۡحٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلُؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا فٰسِقِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And (We have destroyed) the people of NūH even before; indeed they were a sinful people.

verses.ar: وَالسَّمَآءَ بَنَيۡنٰهَا بِاَيۡىدٍ وَّاِنَّا لَمُوۡسِعُوۡنَ
verses.en: And the sky was built by Us with might; and indeed We are the expanders.

verses.ar: وَالۡاَرۡضَ فَرَشۡنٰهَا فَنِعۡمَ الۡمٰهِدُوۡنَ
verses.en: And the earth was spread out by Us as a floor; so how well have We spread it out!

verses.ar: وَمِنۡ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And from every thing We have created pairs of twos, so that you may heed.

verses.ar: فَفِرُّوۡ٘ا اِلَي اللّٰهِؕ اِنِّيۡ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡهُ نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۚ‏
verses.en: So, flee to Allah. Indeed I am a plain warner sent by Him for you.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُوۡا مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَؕ اِنِّيۡ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡهُ نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
verses.en: And do not make up any other god along with Allah. Indeed I am a plain warner sent by Him for you.

verses.ar: كَذٰلِكَ مَا٘ اَتَي الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ مِّنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا قَالُوۡا سَاحِرٌ اَوۡ مَجۡنُوۡنٌࣞ‏
verses.en: In similar way, no messenger came to those before them, but they said, “(He is) a magician or a madman.”

verses.ar: اَتَوَاصَوۡا بِهٖۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ طَاغُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Have they handed down (this saying) to each other as a legacy? Rather they are a rebellious people.

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ بِمَلُوۡمٍؗ‏
verses.en: So, turn away from them, for you are not blamed.

verses.ar: وَّذَكِّرۡ فَاِنَّ الذِّكۡرٰي تَنۡفَعُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: And keep reminding, because reminding benefits the believers.

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ الۡجِنَّ وَالۡاِنۡسَ اِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُوۡنِ
verses.en: I did not create the Jinns and the human beings except for the purpose that they should worship Me.

verses.ar: مَا٘ اُرِيۡدُ مِنۡهُمۡ مِّنۡ رِّزۡقٍ وَّمَا٘ اُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يُّطۡعِمُوۡنِ
verses.en: I do not want any sustenance from them, nor do I want them to feed Me.

verses.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الۡقُوَّةِ الۡمَتِيۡنُ
verses.en: In fact, Allah is the All-Sustainer, Possessor of power, the Strong.

verses.ar: فَاِنَّ لِلَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا ذَنُوۡبًا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوۡبِ اَصۡحٰبِهِمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنِ
verses.en: So, those who did wrong will have their turn like the turn of their counterparts. So, they should not ask Me to hasten on.

verses.ar: فَوَيۡلٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ يَّوۡمِهِمُ الَّذِيۡ يُوۡعَدُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Woe, then, to those who disbelieve because of the Day of theirs that they are promised (for punishment).
